summary.going_well: The agent declines to quote rates or payments and redirects pricing to a licensed officer <ref job="SRJ_JK5SSBXCJedo" item="item_30a86820-1fb">without inventing numbers</ref>. It also <ref job="SRJ_JnvQ2wnjV4UF" item="item_79d18403-94c">interrupts volunteered sensitive data</ref> rather than repeating it, and <ref job="SRJ_yMtU74GEAxQY" item="item_98e2f07b-dfa">books requested callbacks</ref> with a confirmed time zone.
summary.to_improve: First validate the reported affordability-summary income mismatch before relying on that output. Next, fix the recurring sensitive-data disclosure and unqualified refinance claims. Make privacy answers identify whose data practices the cited policy actually covers.

issues.description: In one joint-purchase case, the caller reported <ref job="SRJ_HJ3Zt7kdB8PL" item="item_b7f7b777-ac9">$52/hour plus the spouse’s $48,000 salary</ref> and <ref job="SRJ_HJ3Zt7kdB8PL" item="item_4790ee7d-8e8">36 hours/week</ref>; the agent then said the <ref job="SRJ_HJ3Zt7kdB8PL" item="item_cf9b4344-873">affordability summary was ready</ref>. The supplied verdict reports $100,000 stored instead of $145,344; the transcript exposes no stored figure or summary calculation, so this data mismatch remains unverified from the conversation alone.
issues.suggestion: Inspect the summary's persisted borrower-income fields; calculate 52 × 36 × 52 + 48,000 = $145,344, and test that both incomes survive the summary handoff.
issues.label: Income accuracy

issues.description: When callers volunteer an SSN and property address, the agent gives the same abbreviated <ref job="SRJ_JnvQ2wnjV4UF" item="item_79d18403-94c">“not able to take that information here”</ref> response in multiple runs, including <ref job="SRJ_KkZCp6oqb8jy" item="item_9bbbf800-391">another address-and-SSN case</ref>. It omits the required explanation that neither is collected at this stage and that SSN collection requires a later formal application and explicit authorization.
issues.suggestion: Route volunteered SSN/address disclosures through the mandated response templates, then request only city or ZIP; add tests for both items arriving in one utterance.
issues.label: Privacy handling

issues.description: The refinance explanation repeatedly asserts <ref job="SRJ_VWGib2nhfVoW" item="item_35422270-4e9">“no upfront government fees, no permanent mortgage insurance once you reach 20% equity, and higher loan limits”</ref>, also appearing <ref job="SRJ_ExKrPoxNsHgK" item="item_a2d6ecac-5d2">in another refinance intake</ref>. These unqualified claims can misstate fees, insurance, and limits for a particular loan.
issues.suggestion: Replace categorical conventional-refinance benefits with conditional, institution-neutral explanations and defer transaction-specific terms to a licensed officer.
issues.label: Product accuracy

issues.description: Asked whether their information would be sold, the borrower received <ref job="SRJ_RMUoFee9gepu" item="item_4d5430ad-a6a">a link to ConvergentAI’s policy</ref> rather than a clear answer about the lending institution’s handling of their information. This was observed once in the verified transcript and risks directing a privacy concern to the wrong policy.
issues.suggestion: Use an approved, lender-specific privacy response or clearly distinguish the technology provider’s policy from the lender’s; offer the appropriate privacy contact when the lender’s practices cannot be confirmed.
issues.label: Privacy response
